language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the spoon handle at frames 61–67 in wrist_image and lifts the spoon from the table at frames 72–83 in image and left_ego_image. It carries the spoon over the open drawer, then releases it at frames 143–148 in wrist_image. Frames 153–157 in wrist_image show the spoon resting inside the drawer while the empty gripper withdraws; image confirms it remains in the drawer through frame 161. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
